notes.title: Photo Mode!
notes.content:
Hi Creators!

You can now enter free-cam in Creative Mode to take clean, high-quality screenshots of your creatures. Fly around the scene, find the perfect angle, and capture your creations. The default keybind is Ctrl+P, but this can be rebound in the settings menu.

Also in this update:

 XP is now awarded for defeating NPCs.
 Various bug fixes and improvements, including issues with footsteps, lighting, NPC behaviour, death messages, the tutorial, and more.
 A secret new animation! Hint: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42540009/534edfb4a5c9d7f0a0188fecbb8847a21548d3e7.png


Hope you enjoy the update!

Cheers,
Daniel

notes.title: Cross-platform factory, timed mode, asymmetry, XP and more!
notes.content:
Hey Creature Creators!

A new update is now live with a tonne of new features, fixes and optimizations!

Here is a summary of all the changes:

Added/Removed:
- Add cross-platform factory (i.e., Steam workshop) support to the main menu
- Add timed mode with online leaderboards
- Add asymmetrical body parts functionality
- Add shine and metallic properties to individual body parts
- Add player world chat side-menu
- Add an experience system (XP level is now prepended to online player names)
- Add zoom in/out and flip buttons
- Add button for hold ability
- Add fire breath keybind
- Add role title during the building phase of Kaiju Hunt
- Add setting to optimize lighting
- Remove cash (unlocks, quests, battles, and mini-games now reward XP instead)
- Remove nudge distance check so that parts can be nudged anywhere within the platform (no need for save/load glitch)

Changed:
- Optimize UI and the load time for the main menu and game scenes
- Optimize lighting (lights disabled at threshold distance, lights fade in/out when entering/exiting a dark area and maximum light sources per creature (4 for local and 2 for remote creatures))
- Replace “Big Time Spender” achievement with “Experienced Creature”, since cash has been replaced with experience
- Increase min/max camera angle (clamped while editing)
- Increase max warnings for tiered framerate (250 ticks)
- Reset target framerate to 60fps for mobile on startup
- Move arm body parts from Farm to Cave, Sandbox and City to ensure timed mode quests can be completed
- Double health contributed by body weight
- Show minigame pads in singleplayer worlds
- Prepend modded and beta worlds with coloured tags

Fixed:
- Clamp bones to x=0 when dragging to prevent twisted spines
- Fix critical issue that occurred when players disconnected during a minigame
- Fix statistics not updating on load
- Fix world chat throwing errors when disabled
- Fix all issues with Kaiju Hunt and NPC AI
- Prevent damage from being taken and save/load operations while editing
- Fix Minigamer achievement
- Fix legacy progress data migration issue
- Fix "We Are Alike" comparison check
- Fix raft issues
- Check if eye, pattern and platform exists before showing tutorial
- Reset underwater state on death

If you encounter any issues, or have feedback/suggestions you would like to share, consider joining the official community Discord server: https://discord.gg/sJysbdu


Cheers,
Daniel

notes.title: The Creature Franchise!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I’m super excited to announce that 2 new creature games are in development and are wishlist-able on Steam! To help fund development, I also developed a new website with an official creature-branded merchandise store!

Creature Battle Simulator:
Forge an army of creatures to defeat your opponents in epic battles across distant lands! Duel against your friends online, or conquer the campaign to unlock new parts that upgrade your creatures' stats and abilities. Will you emerge victorious?
https://playcreature.com/creature-battle-simulator
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2489760/Creature_Battle_Simulator

Creature Evolution Simulator:
Design an ecosystem and watch your creatures evolve through millions of years by means of natural selection. See them fight for survival and produce offspring which share their genes… occasionally mutating to form monstrosities! What will your creature’s final-stage of evolution be?
https://playcreature.com/creature-evolution-simulator
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2561380/Creature_Evolution_Simulator

New Website and Merch Store:
To help fund the development of these new games, I have developed a new website with an official merchandise store! If you want these games to become a reality then this is the best way to show your support!
https://playcreature.com/merch
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42540009/b25bcc0fd10a53534d017a289e4c3c9e4c6eefb9.png

Creature Creator Education Edition:
Another big release (which probably deserves its own announcement) is the Education Edition of Creature Creator! Similarly to Minecraft and Roblox, Creature Creator now has an educational edition! This version includes everything from the original, but now enables devices on the same local network to connect to one another, and is available for half the original price as a special discount for schools.
https://playcreature.com/creature-creator/#educate


Thank you all for your continued support! This has been a massive undertaking, but I'm very excited about the future of the CREATURE franchise!

Cheers,
Daniel

notes.title: Minigames!
notes.content:
Compete against friends in 6 new minigames throughout the world of Creature Creator:

 Build Battle - Given a topic, build a creature and then rate your opponents to determine whose is the best! {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42540009/a0bfa26fccae6b1fd330e7fecc5d9a0b1a49ddbd.png
 Race - Be the first to complete three laps around the racetrack! {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42540009/85acc90e36ac1331f35427b922dff33ff6382275.png
 Soccer - Score the most goals for your team before time runs out. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42540009/be5e5d7ab909acb9dccd33229928a151b0c2c013.png
 Pirate King - Occupy the land near the shipwreck for the longest amount of time. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42540009/54a800bf7abc4ffa078fcd110a05111135046679.png
 Fruit Fight - Collect the most fruit for your team. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42540009/765fcd56c674b2fe7674c39f6f78168a81aee82f.png
 Cave Critters - Kill the most spiders in the given time. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42540009/81ce1043b6aafc60353ee07aca88ff5156264c53.png


All minigames follow the same structure! Firstly, players join by entering a glowing pad situated near the starting point. They are then introduced to the minigame via a cinematic, in which an electric bounds is defined around the play area. Next, players are given a period of time to create/modify a creature to compete with. A new system has been introduced to be able to temporarily apply restrictions to build mode to make this more interesting! Once ready, players are then teleported to their starting positions, at which point, the minigame will commence!

If you encounter a bug, please consider reporting it in the community Discord server. Thank you!

Cheers,
Daniel

notes.title: The Factory
notes.content:
The Factory
Share your favorite creatures with the community! Popular trending creatures for the week are featured in the main menu. You can view all the creations in the Steam workshop. To send a creature to the factory (i.e., upload to the Steam workshop), just click on the share button next to its name.

Optimizations
The game underwent some major optimizations which improved both performance and file size! The total size of the application was reduced from ±3GB to ±0.6GB without any noticeable degradations in quality. Creature construction time was also reduced by 85% (previously a large creature would take ±120ms to construct, and now it takes ±20ms). This means no more lag spikes during a multiplayer game session when lots of players are constructing creatures at the same time. The average performance has improved a lot as well due to lots of factors like optimizing creature animation (e.g., disable movement when too far away), GPU instancing, static batching, optimized shaders, terrain and water LOD, occlusion culling, baked lighting, optimized textures and audio, etc.!

Map Changes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42540009/dbbaef17125df6721035ee53d0a4d73e7ce20d77.png
There were also a few changes to the Farm and Cave maps:

Farm: The beach has been populated with palm trees and grasses and a pathway was added to the locked chest. The orchard and ranch were resized and more trees were added. Two moving platforms were added to the lake. Crystals now emit light in the cave. Background terrain was added with extended roads. The number of trees were reduced in the forest. Coins for the "Wishing Well" quest were moved closer to the well. Snakes were removed from the forest.
Cave: Added Basalt platforms and fixed the moss. Lighting is now properly baked as well and light probes have been used for realtime dynamic objects to receive lighting.


Other
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42540009/6839ab0296279f01937641d268151c47db58ab91.png
There are lots of minor changes or improvements, but here are some of the most noteworthy:

Corpses are now edible (nice, cannibalism) and float on water.
Added Turkish language.
Added Night Vision ability.
Added a native file browser for importing and exporting creatures!
Created a new app icon!
Scrolling on a creature's body targets the nearest bone.
Held items are offset to a creature's hand.
Add sense factor to noses and ears (which increases visibility for parts).
Add launcher trajectories.
Right click to flip parts along the local z-axis.
Added camera shake when you take damage.
Limit number of light sources per creature.
NPCs move to different position when attacked.
Prevent drowning when on rafts.
Added ambient particles setting to disable clouds and particles in the cave.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42540009/9035ebb7aba8e978c3c8d946eda19729d6ccb767.png

notes.title: v1.0.52 - Inter-World Travel
notes.content:
In this update, we focus on expanding the open world!

Inter-World Travel
You can now teleport between different maps in both single- and multiplayer! Just navigate to a landmark (e.g., the sandbox in Farm) with everyone online, and teleport! This is in preparation for the "story" update coming soon to adventure mode!

Map Changes
In order to teleport between Island and Farm, there needed to be a link! For this, I added a beach to the previously unreachable top portion of Farm and used the raft which washes up onto the shore of Island to teleport! I've also increased the depth of the ocean on Island, and added an additional forest and background landscape to Farm.

Localization
In other news, the game is currently being translated into 11 different languages (i.e., English, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, French, German, Polish, Thai, Japanese, Korean, Italian and Portuguese)! An official language update will be coming soon once that has been completed, but for now it is in the game for testing and feedback!

Other
The tutorial was updated to include hint messages to help better guide new players, and teach them about the minimap. A few longstanding bugs were finally fixed (including players' age, hunger and health jumping around sporadically), and several smaller ones like projectiles malfunctioning and searching through creatures not working. Additionally, players' movement speed and flapping and jumping was increased slightly. To see a full list of all the changes, you can view the commit history on GitHub.

If you encounter a bug or have a suggestion, consider joining the community Discord server to let us know about it. Thanks!
